newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers slightly down, rest of Europe mixed.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers slightly down, rest of Europe mixed.

text.p: ARA bunkers almost returned to Wednesday's closing levels, after a sudden crash first thing, while other European prices were mixed, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST bunker prices in the afternoon were around $116/$117 fob. Earlier, barges had taken a little time to recover from a $6 crash at the opening. A number of suppliers clamoured to receive fuel oil barges at the $108/$109 level offered, but the seller only released 3,000 tonnes. Dealers said the seller was interested in lower prices to suit a cargo deal.
However, even after the morning recovery, the slight weakness compared with Wednesday drew in buyers.
"We've seen about 20,000 tonnes of enquiries in Rotterdam alone," one supplier said.

Mediterranean prices were mixed. Spain and France gained $2 a tonne, catching up with Wednesday's ARA strength, while Italy and Greece fell about $1. Suppliers, however, could not explain the weakness in the central and eastern Med.
Fujairah nipped up $2 to $116/$118, a repeat of it highest level so far this year.
Offers in Durban also gained $2 a tonne, but bids were reluctant to follow.
